component.name: Lemonade Web App
component.summary: Local AI server with GPU and NPU acceleration - Web Interface

description.p: Lemonade Web App provides a browser-based interface to the Lemonade local AI server. Access the same capabilities as cloud APIs, but 100% free and private. Run the latest models for chat, coding, speech, and image generation on your own NPU and GPU.

ul.li: Browser-based interface for managing AI models and interactions
Multi-modal AI support: chat, speech transcription, text-to-speech, and image generation
GPU and NPU acceleration for optimal performance
Model management with automatic download and optimization
